items.q: Lois McCloud is the coordinator of the project and she works closely with Pastor John Gensel.

ctx.x: again. And I have been talking with Jimmy and Marian McPartland as part of the project which Jazz Interactions is conducting for the National Endowment for the Arts in Washington.
Lois McCloud is the coordinator of the project and she works closely with Pastor John Gensel. the almost renowned in New York at least, Pastor to the jazz community, as he is known.
